tasks.task: On the screener, check the Collectibles and Metals category boxes, type 800 into the minimum price field, and set the status filter to Open.
tasks.expected: Exactly three listings show: 1968 Rolex Submariner, Signed First-Edition Dune, and Gold Krugerrand Coin — the 1974 Fender Stratocaster stays hidden even though it's a Collectible over $800, because it's Settled.

tasks.task: Check only the Metals category box on the screener, then additionally check the Furniture box.
tasks.expected: With Metals alone the live match counter reads 2 with exactly the 10oz Silver Bullion Bar and Gold Krugerrand Coin visible; after adding Furniture the counter reads 4 and both furniture listings join the results — categories combine as either-or, not both-and.

tasks.task: With only the Metals box checked, save the search as a preset named 'Metals watch', clear all filters, then load the 'Metals watch' preset.
tasks.expected: Clearing filters brings back all 7 listings; loading the preset re-applies the Metals filter and the results return to exactly the 10oz Silver Bullion Bar and Gold Krugerrand Coin.

tasks.task: Filter the screener to the Metals category, open the 10oz Silver Bullion Bar listing, place a bid of 360, then open the trading history.
tasks.expected: The 360 bid on the 10oz Silver Bullion Bar appears as a new entry in the trading history.

tasks.task: Open the trading history section of the account area.
tasks.expected: A trading history view renders without errors, showing past trading and bidding activity (or a sensible empty state if nothing has happened yet).

tasks.task: Open the bid ticket on the Signed First-Edition Dune listing and type 905 as your bid amount.
tasks.expected: Before any submit, the ticket live-shows a buyer's premium of $113.13, a $25.00 handling fee, and a total due of $1,043.13 — the half-cent on the premium rounds up, so $113.13 rather than $113.12.

tasks.task: Open the bid ticket on the Gold Krugerrand Coin, type 2100, then change it to 2150.
tasks.expected: 2100 is rejected with a message about the $100 minimum increment (current bid is $2,050.00 so the floor is $2,150.00) and cannot be submitted; changing to 2150 clears the error and the ticket becomes submittable.

tasks.task: On the Signed First-Edition Dune bid ticket, type 900, then delete the amount so the field is empty.
tasks.expected: While 900 is typed the total due reads $1,037.50 without submitting anything; once the field is emptied the ticket falls back to a calm neutral state — no NaN, no crash, no stale total left behind.

tasks.task: Bid 360 on the 10oz Silver Bullion Bar through the ticket, go through the confirmation step, then open the trading history.
tasks.expected: A confirmation summary appears first showing the $360.00 bid and the $430.00 total due; after confirming, the bid shows up in the trading history.

tasks.task: Open the My Watchlist section on the dashboard.
tasks.expected: The Gold Krugerrand Coin and Antique Oak Writing Desk are there from the start, the combined current-bid value reads $3,200.00, and the Desk wears the amber Closing pill.

tasks.task: From the browse listings, star the Persian Heriz Rug, then open My Watchlist.
tasks.expected: The watchlist now holds 3 items and the combined current-bid value reads $4,180.00 — updated immediately, no reload needed.

tasks.task: In My Watchlist, unstar the Gold Krugerrand Coin and the Antique Oak Writing Desk.
tasks.expected: The watchlist empties gracefully into a friendly empty-state message — no blank screen, no $NaN or leftover stale total.

tasks.task: On the screener, turn on the watched-only toggle and check the Metals category box, then turn the watched-only toggle back off.
tasks.expected: With both on, only the Gold Krugerrand Coin matches (watched AND Metals together); toggling watched-only off brings the 10oz Silver Bullion Bar back alongside it.

tasks.task: Start the close-and-settle flow on the Antique Oak Writing Desk and look at the invoice review step.

tasks.task: Open the Completed Sales page, type 'Attic' into its search box, then replace it with 'zzz'.

tasks.expected: The invoice picks up the fresh $1,250.00 winning bid and the total due reads $1,431.25 — the same premium-plus-handling math the bid ticket previews.
